title: Missing-attendance edit resolution fix
userReport: User reported that 확인 필요한 미기록 수업 should disappear after 수정/save but did not.
changes: Added markAttendanceProposalResolved and isAttendanceProposalSuppressed so resolved proposal keys are tracked explicitly.
Saving a lesson record now marks the matching scheduled missing-attendance proposal as lesson-record-saved.
Single and batch proposal confirmations also mark exact proposal keys as confirmed/batch-confirmed.
Resolved marks only suppress while a matching lesson log still exists; deleted logs can surface as proposals again.
Bumped service worker cache version to vs-v2-2026-06-19-attendance-resolve-fix.

localBrowser.scenario: Synthetic past fixed lesson proposal, open lesson record, save, then collect proposals again.

residualBlockers: G004/G005 live split-write and Storage upload receipts still require a logged-in admin browser to run 관리자 검증 → 라이브 G004/G005 검증 and provide/copy the JSON receipt.
